text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Allllright! A clean victory over her!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka took the first victory
in their GⅠ prelude showdown against Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can charge right into the Classic races
feeling great. How'd I look, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ain't that right, ain't that right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Honestly though, I was sweating for a sec.
That guy's gotten surprisingly powered up too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Flattering people
isn't like you at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Scarlet. Well, looks like you're trying hard,
but you've still got a long way to go."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, today is the only time I'm letting you take the spotlight!
This race is nothing more than a prelude to the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The real showdown is next!
I'll definitely turn the tables at the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, bring it on.
I'll dust you next time just as easily!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka gives a cool smirk
and walks away with the composure of a victor.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... regarding Vodka's running form,
has it changed a little?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's as unpolished as ever, but
it's like she's gained a formidable presence...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What kind of training have you been doing?
choice_data_list: It's probably the result of real-race experience.
It's probably the result of real-race experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka had fearlessly challenged GⅠ races
from an early stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems the fruits of pushing your limits to take on challengesare showing in your races as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Actual races... Right...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When she suddenly started talking about G1s last year,
I thought she was just being an idiot again, but
it turns out she had her reasons after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, only just a tiny bit!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
I'll see just what you're made of.
At our next real race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next big stage’—
It sounds like a natural promise, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, guess that means they're not just some goody two-shoes.
Things are startin' to get interestin'.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer, about the next race,
it's obviously gonna be the 'Oka Sho', right?"
choice_data_list: It's not that simple, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What do you mean?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Triple Crown route" and the "Triple Tiara route."
I will now explain the two racing formats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If one enters the Oka Sho on the Tiara route, the standard path is to follow it up with the Yushun Himba and the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we aim for the Triple Tiara,
we must give up on the Triple Crown route's Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So if I go to the Oka Sho, does that mean
I won't be able to run in the Derby?!
choice_data_list: It's not impossible, but nobody normally does it.
It's not impossible, but nobody normally does that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You only get one chance in a lifetime to challenge the Triple Crown or the Triple Tiara.
Throwing away that opportunity with your race choices is normally unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, what the heck am I supposed to do then?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To face that guy in the Classics now that he's
finally gotten stronger, do I really gotta give up on the Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. How about something like this!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about running in all six races
of both the Triple Crown and the Tiara, and winning every single one?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really~!?
What are we supposed to do with this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It is a momentous question.
Take the Tiara route to face her rivals, or aim for the Classic Triple Crown to run in the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's probably no right answer. But Vodka and I
have to find our own solution together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, something just came to mind.
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bring myself to drop either of 'em. Before, I'd
have cut that guy loose without a second thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet's running today felt different somehow.
I could sense real spirit that wasn't just talk, and immense potential.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't shake this burning desire to take her on in a real GⅠ.
So—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about going from the Oka Sho straight to the Japanese Derby?
I think that's our only real option.
choice_data_list: Are you giving up on the Triple Crown and the Triple Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I didn't say I was giving up!
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is the only thing I can think of!
If I want to chase after everything I refuse to give up—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her voice was filled with resolve. It might be premature to make a decision at this stage, but...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Oka Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-You understand, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: However, let's leave the rest for after the race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So she means we'll talk after the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's do that.
Yeah... it ain't something to take lightly anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, but this means you don't get to run away with the win.
First up, I'm taking her on in the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've decided not to choose my path just yet.
Everything depends on the outcome of the Oka Sho, and my resolve thereafter.
